ai_review.summary: Rare Scarlet > Touch of Grey > Fire sequence captured, but recording source and audio quality are not identified.
ai_review.review: The reviewer highlights the unusual second‑set run of Scarlet Begonias → Touch of Grey → Fire, noting it is one of only two known occurrences. No information about the tape source or sound clarity is provided, leaving the technical quality uncertain.

ai_rating.rationale: The show is praised for a rare song sequence, but with only one review and no data on recording fidelity, confidence in the overall rating is limited.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review does not mention soundboard or audience details; no comments on clarity, balance, or noise.
